function getQatarNowParts() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Qatar',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(new Date());

  const map = {};
  parts.forEach(function(p) {
    if (p.type !== 'literal') map[p.type] = p.value;
  });

  return {
    date: `${map.year}-${map.month}-${map.day}`,
    minutes: parseInt(map.hour, 10) * 60 + parseInt(map.minute, 10)
  };
}

function hasAffectedShiftEnded(date, shiftLabel) {
  if (!date || !shiftLabel) return false;

  const now = getQatarNowParts();
  const shift = String(shiftLabel).toUpperCase();

  let end = null;

  if (shift.includes('TWILIGHT AM')) {
    end = 16 * 60;
  } else if (shift.includes('TWILIGHT PM')) {
    end = 20 * 60;
  } else if (shift.includes('AM SHIFT')) {
    end = 14 * 60;
  } else if (shift.includes('PM SHIFT')) {
    end = 22 * 60;
  }

  if (end === null) return false;

  if (now.date > date) return true;
  if (now.date < date) return false;

  return now.minutes >= end;
}


let quietTickerIndex = 0;
let abuNakhlaPrayerTimes = null;
let abuNakhlaPrayerFetchDate = null;

function getQatarClock() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Qatar',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    hour12: false
  }).formatToParts(new Date());

  const map = {};
  parts.forEach(function(part) {
    if (part.type !== 'literal') map[part.type] = part.value;
  });

  return {
    isoDate: `${map.year}-${map.month}-${map.day}`,
    apiDate: `${map.day}-${map.month}-${map.year}`,
    minutes: (parseInt(map.hour, 10) * 60) + parseInt(map.minute, 10)
  };
}

function getCurrentShiftPeriod() {
  const now = getQatarClock().minutes;

  if (now >= 7 * 60 && now < 14 * 60) return 'AM';
  if (now >= 16 * 60 && now < 22 * 60) return 'PM';

  return null;
}

function formatPrayerTime12h(value) {
  if (!value) return '';
  const clean = String(value).split(' ')[0].trim();
  const parts = clean.split(':');
  if (parts.length < 2) return clean;

  let hour = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
  const minute = parts[1];
  const suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';

  hour = hour % 12;
  if (hour === 0) hour = 12;

  return `${hour}:${minute} ${suffix}`;
}

function prayerTimeToMinutes(value) {
  if (!value) return null;
  const raw = String(value).trim();
  const ampm = /\b(AM|PM)\b/i.exec(raw);
  const parts = raw.replace(/\s*(AM|PM).*/i, '').split(':');
  if (parts.length < 2) return null;
  let h = parseInt(parts[0],10);
  const min = parseInt(parts[1],10);
  if (isNaN(h) || isNaN(min)) return null;
  if (ampm) {
    const isPM = ampm[1].toUpperCase() === 'PM';
    h = h % 12;
    if (isPM) h += 12;
  }
  return h * 60 + min;
}

function getActiveUserShiftWindowToday() {
  const today = getTodayScheduleDay();
  if (!today || !activeUserDocName) return null;

  const briefing = chooseSingleDailyBriefing(today, activeUserDocName);
  if (!briefing || !briefing.title) return null;

  const title = briefing.title;
  if (title.indexOf('09:00–16:00') !== -1 || title.indexOf('AM Twilight') !== -1) {
    return {start:9*60, end:16*60, label:'AM Twilight 9–4'};
  }
  if (title.indexOf('14:00–20:00') !== -1 || title.indexOf('PM Twilight') !== -1) {
    return {start:14*60, end:20*60, label:'PM Twilight 2–8'};
  }
  if (title.indexOf('AM shift') !== -1) {
    return {start:7*60, end:14*60, label:'AM shift'};
  }
  if (title.indexOf('PM shift') !== -1) {
    return {start:16*60, end:22*60, label:'PM shift'};
  }

function getActiveUserShiftWindowToday() {
  const today = getTodayScheduleDay();
  if (!today || !activeUserDocName) return null;

  const briefing = chooseSingleDailyBriefing(today, activeUserDocName);
  if (!briefing || !briefing.title) return null;

  const title = briefing.title;
  if (title.indexOf('09:00–16:00') !== -1 || title.indexOf('AM Twilight') !== -1) {
    return {start:9*60, end:16*60, label:'AM Twilight 9–4'};
  }
  if (title.indexOf('14:00–20:00') !== -1 || title.indexOf('PM Twilight') !== -1) {
    return {start:14*60, end:20*60, label:'PM Twilight 2–8'};
  }
  if (title.indexOf('AM shift') !== -1) {
    return {start:7*60, end:14*60, label:'AM shift'};
  }
  if (title.indexOf('PM shift') !== -1) {
    return {start:16*60, end:22*60, label:'PM shift'};
  }
  return null;
}

async function fetchAbuNakhlaPrayerTimes() {
  const now = getQatarClock();

  if (abuNakhlaPrayerTimes && abuNakhlaPrayerFetchDate === now.isoDate) {
    return abuNakhlaPrayerTimes;
  }

  try {
    // Abu Nakhla Health Centre area, Qatar.
    const latitude = ABU_NAKHLA_LAT;
    const longitude = ABU_NAKHLA_LNG;
    const url =
      `https://api.aladhan.com/v1/timings/${now.apiDate}` +
      `?latitude=${latitude}&longitude=${longitude}&method=8`;

    const response = await fetch(url);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Prayer time request failed');

    const payload = await response.json();
    const timings = payload && payload.data && payload.data.timings;
    if (!timings) throw new Error('Prayer times unavailable');

    abuNakhlaPrayerTimes = {
      Fajr: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Fajr),
      Dhuhr: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Dhuhr),
      Asr: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Asr),
      Maghrib: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Maghrib),
      Isha: formatPrayerTime12h(timings.Isha)
    };
    abuNakhlaPrayerFetchDate = now.isoDate;
    return abuNakhlaPrayerTimes;
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
}

function getActiveTickerMeta() {
  return Storage.getJSON('rotastic_active_announcement_meta', {}) || {};
}

function getTickerSourceMeta(type, message) {
  const text = String(message || '');

  if(type==='worldnews') return rotasticCurrentTickerSourceMeta||{name:'Al Jazeera English',domain:'aljazeera.com'};
  if(type==='alarabiyanews') return rotasticCurrentTickerSourceMeta||{name:'Al Arabiya',domain:'english.alarabiya.net'};
  if(type==='reutersnews') return rotasticCurrentTickerSourceMeta||{name:'Reuters',domain:'reuters.com'};

  if (type === 'qnanews') {
    return {
      name:'Qatar News Agency',
      domain:'qna.org.qa'
    };
  }

  if (type === 'prayer') {
    return {
      name:'AlAdhan Prayer Times',
      domain:'aladhan.com'
    };
  }

  if (type === 'stat' && /\bPHCC\b/i.test(text)) {
    return {
      name:'Primary Health Care Corporation',
      domain:'phcc.gov.qa'
    };
  }

  if (type === 'medicalnews') {
    return rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta || {
      name:'Medical News',
      domain:'news.google.com'
    };
  }

  if (type === 'nhsinfo') {
    return {
      name:'NHS',
      domain:'nhs.uk'
    };
  }

  if (type === 'clinical' && /\bPHCC\b/i.test(text)) {
    return {
      name:'Primary Health Care Corporation',
      domain:'phcc.gov.qa'
    };
  }

  return null;
}

function getTickerDisplayTitle(type) {
  return (
    type === 'rota' ? 'ROTA' :
    type === 'welcome' || type === 'greeting' ? 'GREETING' :
    type === 'stat' ? 'MEDICAL\nSTAT' :
    type === 'qatar' ? 'QATAR\nFACT' :
    type === 'qnanews' ? 'QNA\nNEWS' :
    type === 'medicalnews' ? 'MEDICAL' :
    type === 'worldnews' ? 'MENA\nNEWS' :
    type === 'alarabiyanews' ? 'MENA\nNEWS' :
    type === 'reutersnews' ? 'REUTERS' :
    type === 'nhsinfo' ? 'NHS\nHEALTH' :
    type === 'safepractice' ? 'SAFE\nPRACTICE' :
    type === 'encouragement' ? 'GOOD\nVIBES' :
    type === 'prayer' ? 'PRAYER' :
    type === 'clinical' ? 'CLINICAL' :
    type === 'sick' ? 'BREAKING' :
    type === 'admin' ? 'ADMIN' :
    type === 'traffic' ? 'TRAFFIC' :
    'UPDATE'
  );
}

function compactTickerSourceName(name) {
  const raw = String(name || '').trim();
  const map = {
    'Al Jazeera English':'Al Jazeera',
    'Qatar News Agency':'QNA',
    'AlAdhan Prayer Times':'AlAdhan',
    'Primary Health Care Corporation':'PHCC',
    'Medical News':'Medical News',
    'NICE':'NICE',
    'Google News':'Google News',
    'Reuters':'Reuters'
  };
  return map[raw] || raw;
}

function getGreetingTickerIcon() {
  let hour = new Date().getHours();
  try {
    hour = parseInt(
      new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
        timeZone:'Asia/Qatar',
        hour:'2-digit',
        hour12:false
      }).format(new Date()),
      10

function getTickerDisplayTitle(type) {
  return (
    type === 'rota' ? 'ROTA' :
    type === 'welcome' || type === 'greeting' ? 'GREETING' :
    type === 'stat' ? 'MEDICAL\nSTAT' :
    type === 'qatar' ? 'QATAR\nFACT' :
    type === 'qnanews' ? 'QNA\nNEWS' :
    type === 'medicalnews' ? 'MEDICAL' :
    type === 'worldnews' ? 'MENA\nNEWS' :
    type === 'alarabiyanews' ? 'MENA\nNEWS' :
    type === 'reutersnews' ? 'REUTERS' :
    type === 'nhsinfo' ? 'NHS\nHEALTH' :
    type === 'safepractice' ? 'SAFE\nPRACTICE' :
    type === 'encouragement' ? 'GOOD\nVIBES' :
    type === 'prayer' ? 'PRAYER' :
    type === 'clinical' ? 'CLINICAL' :
    type === 'sick' ? 'BREAKING' :
    type === 'admin' ? 'ADMIN' :
    type === 'traffic' ? 'TRAFFIC' :
    'UPDATE'
  );
}

function compactTickerSourceName(name) {
  const raw = String(name || '').trim();
  const map = {
    'Al Jazeera English':'Al Jazeera',
    'Qatar News Agency':'QNA',
    'AlAdhan Prayer Times':'AlAdhan',
    'Primary Health Care Corporation':'PHCC',
    'Medical News':'Medical News',
    'NICE':'NICE',
    'Google News':'Google News',
    'Reuters':'Reuters'
  };
  return map[raw] || raw;
}

function getGreetingTickerIcon() {
  let hour = new Date().getHours();
  try {
    hour = parseInt(
      new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
        timeZone:'Asia/Qatar',
        hour:'2-digit',
        hour12:false
      }).format(new Date()),
      10
    );
  } catch (e) {}

  if (hour >= 17) return 'fa-solid fa-moon text-indigo-300 rotastic-moon-animate';
  if (hour >= 12) return 'fa-solid fa-cloud-sun text-amber-300 rotastic-cloudsun-animate';
  return 'fa-solid fa-sun text-amber-300 rotastic-sun-animate';
}

const rotasticTickerHistory = [];
let rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = -1;
let rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing = false;
let rotasticTickerTouchStartX = 0;
let rotasticTickerTouchStartY = 0;

function rememberRotasticTickerItem(type, message) {
  if (rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing) return;
  const text = String(message || '').trim();
  if (!text) return;

  const last = rotasticTickerHistory[rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1];
  if (last && last.type === type && last.message === text) {
    rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1;
    return;
  }

  rotasticTickerHistory.push({
    type:type || 'general',
    message:text,
    medicalLink:type === 'medicalnews' ? rotasticCurrentMedicalLink : ''
  });

  if (rotasticTickerHistory.length > 30) rotasticTickerHistory.shift();
  rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1;
}

  const item = rotasticTickerHistory[bounded];
  if (!item) return;

  rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = bounded;
  rotasticTicker

function normalizeFeedTitle(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&#39;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .trim();
}

async function fetchRssJson(url) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}});
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Feed request failed');
  const payload = await response.json();
  return Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : [];
}

function regionalMedicalFeedUrl(query) {
  return 'https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=' +
    encodeURIComponent(
      'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=' +
      encodeURIComponent(query) +
      '&hl=en&gl=QA&ceid=QA:en'
    );
}

function isBoringInstitutionalHealthHeadline(title) {
  const value = String(title || '').toLowerCase();
  return (
    /\b(publications?|homepage|portal|newsletter|annual report|media center|media centre)\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\b(latest|new)\s+(health|public health|primary care)?\s*updates?\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\bministry of public health\s*[-–:]?\s*publications?\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\bphcc\s*[-–:]?\s*(latest|updates?|publications?)\b/i.test(value)
  );
}

function regionalMedicalFeedUrl(query) {
  return 'https://api.rss2json.com/v1/api.json?rss_url=' +
    encodeURIComponent(
      'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=' +
      encodeURIComponent(query) +
      '&hl=en&gl=QA&ceid=QA:en'
    );
}

function isBoringInstitutionalHealthHeadline(title) {
  const value = String(title || '').toLowerCase();
  return (
    /\b(publications?|homepage|portal|newsletter|annual report|media center|media centre)\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\b(latest|new)\s+(health|public health|primary care)?\s*updates?\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\bministry of public health\s*[-–:]?\s*publications?\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\bphcc\s*[-–:]?\s*(latest|updates?|publications?)\b/i.test(value)
  );
}

function isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(title, sourceName) {
  const t=String(title||'').toLowerCase().trim(), s=String(sourceName||'').toLowerCase();
  if(!t||/publications?|newsletter|latest updates?|homepage|minister meets|conference to open/i.test(t)) return false;
  const topic=/(family medicine|primary care|general practice|randomized|trial|meta-analysis|guideline|glp-1|semaglutide|tirzepatide|obesity|diabetes|hypertension|cardiovascular|screening|vaccine|measles|influenza|antibiotic|antimicrobial|mental health|cancer|microbiome|dementia|asthma|copd|smoking|prevention)/i;
  const trusted=/(jama|nejm|lancet|bmj|nature|annals|medscape|who|cdc|fda|sidra|hamad)/i;
  return topic.test(t)&&(trusted.test(t)||trusted.test(s));
}

function cleanInterestingMedicalTickerText(title, sourceName) {
  return cleanRegionalMedicalHeadline(title, sourceName);
}

  const value = String(title || '').toLowerCase();
  return (
    /\b(publications?|homepage|portal|newsletter|annual report|media center|media centre)\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\b(latest|new)\s+(health|public health|primary care)?\s*updates?\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\bministry of public health\s*[-–:]?\s*publications?\b/i.test(value) ||
    /\bphcc\s*[-–:]?\s*(latest|updates?|publications?)\b/i.test(value)
  );
}

function isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(title, sourceName) {
  const t=String(title||'').toLowerCase().trim(), s=String(sourceName||'').toLowerCase();
  if(!t||/publications?|newsletter|latest updates?|homepage|minister meets|conference to open/i.test(t)) return false;
  const topic=/(family medicine|primary care|general practice|randomized|trial|meta-analysis|guideline|glp-1|semaglutide|tirzepatide|obesity|diabetes|hypertension|cardiovascular|screening|vaccine|measles|influenza|antibiotic|antimicrobial|mental health|cancer|microbiome|dementia|asthma|copd|smoking|prevention)/i;
  const trusted=/(jama|nejm|lancet|bmj|nature|annals|medscape|who|cdc|fda|sidra|hamad)/i;
  return topic.test(t)&&(trusted.test(t)||trusted.test(s));
}

function cleanInterestingMedicalTickerText(title, sourceName) {
  return cleanRegionalMedicalHeadline(title, sourceName);
}

async function fetchRegionalMedicalSource(source) {
  try {
    const items = await fetchRssJson(regionalMedicalFeedUrl(source.query));

    return items
      .map(function(item) {
        return {
          title: normalizeFeedTitle(item.title),
          link: String(item.link || item.url || source.home || ''),
          sourceName: source.name,
          domain: source.domain,
          priority: source.priority || 1
        };
      })
      .filter(function(item) {
        return item.title &&
          item.title.length > 18 &&
          isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName);
      })
      .map(function(item) {
        item.title = cleanInterestingMedicalTickerText(item.title, item.sourceName);
        return item;
      })
      .slice(0,6);
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

function cleanRegionalMedicalHeadline(title, sourceName) {
  let value = String(title || '')
    .replace(/\s+-\s+Google News\s*$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s+-\s+[^-]{2,45}$/i, function(match) {
      const source = String(sourceName || '').toLowerCase();
      const tail = match.toLowerCase();
      return tail.includes(source.split(' ')[0]) ? '' : match;
    })
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
  return fitNormalTickerCopy(value, 15, 108);
}


async function fetchRotasticNewsProxy(kind) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(
      ROTASTIC_NEWS_PROXY_ENDPOINT + '?kind=' + encodeURIComponent(kind || 'medical'),
      {headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}}
    );
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('ROTASTIC news proxy request failed');
    const payload = await response.json();
    return Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : [];
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

function chooseNiceGuidanceTickerItem() {
  const item = ROTASTIC_NICE_GUIDANCE_UPDATES[Math.floor(Math.random() * ROTASTIC_NICE_GUIDANCE_UPDATES.length)];
  if (!item) return '';
  rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:'NICE', domain:'nice.org.uk'};
  rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = item.link || 'https://www.nice.org.uk/';
  return makeShortMedicalHeadline(item.title, 'NICE') || '';
}

function mergeNiceGuidanceIntoMedicalHeadlines(items) {
  const current = Array.isArray(items) ? items.slice() : [];
  const seen = new Set(current.map(function(item) {
    return String(item && item.link || '') + '|' + String(item && item.title || '');
  }));

  ROTASTIC_NICE_GUIDANCE_UPDATES.forEach(function(item) {
    const key = String(item.link || '') + '|' + String(item.title || '');
    if (!seen.has(key)) {
      current.push(Object.assign({}, item));
      seen.add(key);
    }
  });

  return current
    .filter(function(item) { return item && item.title; })
    .sort(function(a,b) { return Number(b.priority || 0) - Number(a.priority || 0); });
}

        .map(function(item) {

        });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines =
      (Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_regional_medical_headlines', []) || []).filter(function(item) {
        return item && item.title && isRelevantFamilyMedicineHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName);
      });
  }

  rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines = mergeNiceGuidanceIntoMedicalHeadlines(
    rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines
  ).slice(0,50);

  // The same backend proxy provides reliable QNA / Al Jazeera current headlines.
  try {

    rotasticNhsHeadlines = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_nhs_headlines', []) || [];

function makeShortMedicalHeadline(title, sourceName) {
  const raw = String(title || '')
    .replace(/\s+-\s+Google News\s*$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s+-\s+(NICE|Medscape|JAMA|NEJM|The Lancet|BMJ|Sidra Medicine|Hamad Medical Corporation)\s*$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
  const direct = fitNormalTickerCopy(raw, 15, 108);
  if (direct) return direct;
  const t = raw.toLowerCase();
  const rules = [
    [/meningococcal/, 'Meningococcal disease: recognition, treatment and prevention'],
    [/microbiome/, 'Microbiome research may reshape future therapies'],
    [/(glp-?1|tirzepatide)/, 'New GLP-1 evidence relevant to primary care'],
    [/diabet.*renal|renal.*diabet/, 'Diabetes care: protect cardiovascular and renal health'],
    [/obes|weight loss|weight management/, 'New evidence in obesity treatment and weight management'],
    [/hypertens|blood pressure/, 'New evidence in hypertension diagnosis and treatment'],
    [/asthma/, 'New evidence in asthma diagnosis and treatment'],
    [/(copd|chronic obstructive)/, 'New evidence in COPD management'],
    [/sepsis/, 'Updated sepsis recognition and management guidance'],
    [/vaccin|immunis|immuniz/, 'New evidence in vaccination practice'],
    [/antibiotic|antimicrobial/, 'New antimicrobial prescribing evidence'],
    [/mental health|depress|anxiety/, 'New evidence in primary-care mental health'],
    [/screening/, 'New evidence in screening practice'],
    [/thyroid/, 'New evidence in thyroid diagnosis and management'],
    [/family medicine|primary care|general practice/, 'New evidence relevant to family medicine'],
    [/clinical trial|randomi[sz]ed trial/, 'Important new clinical trial relevant to primary care'],
    [/guideline|guidance/, 'Important new clinical guidance for primary care']
  ];
  for (const rule of rules) if (rule[0].test(t)) return fitNormalTickerCopy(rule[1], 15, 108);
  return '';
}

function chooseLatestMedicalHeadline() {
  rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = '';

  let regional = rotasticRegionalMedicalHeadlines;

  if (!regional.length) {
    regional =
      Storage.getJSON('rotastic_cached_regional_medical_headlines', []) || [];
  }

  // Prefer Qatar / Arab-region clinical news strongly.
  if (regional.length) {
    const top = regional.slice(0, Math.min(regional.length, 20));
    const totalWeight = top.reduce(function(sum, item) {
      return sum + Math.max(1, Number(item.priority || 1));
    }, 0);

    let pick = Math.random() * totalWeight;
    let chosen = top[0];

    for (const item of top) {
      pick -= Math.max(1, Number(item.priority || 1));
      if (pick <= 0) {
        chosen = item;
        break;
      }
    }

    rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {
      name:chosen.sourceName,
      domain:chosen.domain
    };
    // Avoid repeating a recently shown medical headline/summary.
    const candidates = top.filter(function(item) {
      const summary = makeShortMedicalHeadline(item.title, item.sourceName);
      return summary && !rotasticRecentMedicalHeadlines.includes(summary);
    });
    if (candidates.length) {
      chosen = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
      rotasticCurrentMedicalSourceMeta = {name:chosen.sourceName, domain:chosen.domain};
    }
    rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = String(chosen.link || '');

    

===== KEY=obesity POS=1664476 =====
 const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!text || text.includes('…') || text.includes('...')) return '';
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length > Number(maxWords || 16)) return '';
  if (text.length > Number(maxChars || 112)) return '';
  return text;
}

function getTickerCopySizeClass(message) {
  const text = String(message || '').trim();
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  if (words <= 8 && text.length <= 58) return 'ticker-copy-short';
  if (words <= 12 && text.length <= 86) return 'ticker-copy-medium';
  return 'ticker-copy-long';
}

function conciseTickerText(value, maxChars) {
  const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const max = Math.max(58, Number(maxChars || 92));
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  return '';
}

function getPrayerTickerMessage(prayerTimes) {
  return choosePrayerMessage(prayerTimes) || '';
}

function defaultPhysicianRule(docName) {
  if (docName === 'Dr Zaid SE.') {
    return { employment:'supernumerary', exemptWBC:true, exemptANC:true, exemptEmergency:true, exemptCodeBlue:true, exemptTwilight:true };
  }
  // The six signed reference rotas do not place Dr Abdul Ghafoor on 9–4 / 2–8.
  // Keep this as an editable default, not a hard-coded prohibition.
  if (docName === 'Dr Abdulgafoor K.') {
    return { employment:'permanent', exemptWBC:false, exemptANC:false, exemptEmergency:false, exemptCodeBlue:false, exemptTwilight:true };
  }
  return { employment:'permanent', exemptWBC:false, exemptANC:false, exemptEmergency:false, exemptCodeBlue:false, exemptTwilight:false };
}

function getPhysicianRules() {
  const stored = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_physician_rules', {});
  const rules = (stored && typeof stored === 'object' && !Array.isArray(stored)) ? stored : {};
  DOCTORS.forEach(function(doc) {
    if (!rules[doc.name]) rules[doc.name] = defaultPhysicianRule(doc.name);
  });
  return rules;
}

function normalizePhysicianRule(docName, rule) {
  const merged = Object.assign({}, defaultPhysicianRule(docName), rule || {});
  // Existing supernumerary records created before Twilight exemption existed
  // default to Twilight-exempt, while remaining fully editable.
  if (merged.employment === 'supernumerary' && (!rule || typeof rule.exemptTwilight !== 'boolean')) merged.exemptTwilight = true;
  return merged;
}

function saveKnownPhysicianEmail(docName, email) {
  const map = getPhysicianEmailMap();

async function issueActivationCodeForPhysician(docName) {
  if (!canIssuePhysicianActivationCodes()) {
    alert('Activation codes are available in Admin View.');
    return;
  }

  let email = getKnownPhysicianEmail(docName);
  email = String(prompt('PHCC email for ' + docName, email || '') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!email) return;
  if (!/^\S+@phcc\.gov\.qa$/i.test(email)) {
    alert('Enter a valid PHCC work email.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    await rotasticBackendEnsureSession();
    if (!rotasticBackendClient || !rotasticBackendUser) throw new Error('Verified Admin sign-in is required.');

    const allowedCheck = await rotasticBackendClient.rpc('rotastic_email_is_authorized',{p_email:email});
    if (allowedCheck.error) throw allowedCheck.error;
    if (!allowedCheck.data) {
      const authResult = await rotasticBackendClient.rpc('rotastic_add_authorized_physician', {
        p_email: email,
        p_physician_name: docName
      });
      if (authResult.error) throw authResult.error;
    }

    const issue = await rotasticBackendClient.rpc('rotastic_issue_registration_code', {
      p_email: email,
      p_physician_name: docName
    });
    if (issue.error) throw issue.error;
    const issued = Array.isArray(issue.data) ? issue.data[0] : issue.data;
    const code = String(issued && issued.registration_code || '');
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) throw new Error('The registration service did not return a valid code.');

    saveKnownPhysicianEmail(docName, email);
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code); } catch (e) {}
    alert(docName + '\n\nActivation code: ' + code + '\n\nSingle use · valid for 24 hours.\nUse again to generate a code for another device.');
    renderPhysicianManagement();
  } catch (e) {
    alert((e && e.message) || 'Could not generate an activation code.');


===== KEY=salah POS=1483549 =====

    if (!rejected && (accepted || (!pending && !status))) addDoctor(item.doc);
  });

  // Immediate sick-leave mirror used by backend sync.
  const sick = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_sick_leave_records', []);
  (Array.isArray(sick) ? sick : []).forEach(function(item) {
    if (item && item.doc && item.date === isoDate) addDoctor(item.doc);
  });

  return found.size;
}

function getShiftLeaveCount(day, period) {
  if (!day) return 0;
  const dayIndex = Math.max(0, currentSchedule.indexOf(day));
  const selected = getWednesdayAMOBGroupValue() || 'Group 1';
  const groupNo = getGroupForPeriod(dayIndex, period === 'am' ? 'AM' : 'PM', selected);
  const rules = getAutoRotaRules();
  const group = groupNo === 1 ? (rules.group1 || []) : (rules.group2 || []);
  const groupSet = new Set((group || []).map(canonicalRotaName).filter(Boolean));

  // These three physicians appear in the signed rota cohorts but were omitted from
  // the old auto-group arrays. Use their historical cohort only for leave counting
  // so the AM/PM card matches the visible daily leave roster without changing rota generation.
  const historicalLeaveCohort = {
    'Dr Laila A.':1,
    'Dr Salah M.':1,
    'Dr Saba T.':2
  };

  const counted = new Set();
  getDisplayedLeaveDoctorsForDay(day).forEach(function(name){
    const doctor = canonicalRotaName(name);
    if (!doctor) return;
    if (groupSet.has(doctor) || historicalLeaveCohort[doctor] === groupNo) counted.add(doctor);
  });

  // Explicit shift-specific reports always win, including physicians outside the
  // normal cohort tables. This is especially important for same-day sick leave.
  Storage.getJSON('rotastic_leave_submissions', []).forEach(function(item){
    if (!item || !item.doc || !item.startDate) return;
    const end = item.endDate || item.startDate;
    if (day.isoDate < item.startDate || day.isoDate > end) return;
    const shiftText = String(item.shift || '').toUpperCase();
    const applies = period === 'am'
      ? (shiftText.indexOf('AM') !== -1 || shiftText.indexOf('09:00') !== -1 || shiftText.indexOf('9-4') !== -1)
      : (shiftText.indexOf('PM') !== -1 || shiftText.indexOf('14:00') !== -1 || shiftText.indexOf('16:00') !== -1 || shiftText.indexOf('2-8') !== -1);
    if (applies) counted.add(canonicalRotaName(item.doc));
  });

  return Array.from(counted).filter(Boolean).length;
}

  const headerRoomText = headerRooms.length ? ('Room ' + headerRooms.join(' / ')) : 'Room —';
  const headerDuration = isAM ? '7 hours' : '6 hours';
  const headerDayDate = [s.day, s.date].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  const shiftLeaveCount = getShiftLeaveCount(s, period);
  const dayLeaveCount = getDayDisplayedLeaveCount(s);

  const emergencyBlock = `
    <div class="rotastic-shift-fit-col">

        <div class="rotastic-er-cell"><span class="text-orange-200/55 block uppercase font-bold">Male ER</span><strong class="text-white">${renderDocBadgeWithSiren(sh.med, s.isoDate, periodLabel)}</strong></div>

function filterDay(idx) {
  activeDayIndex = idx;

  document.querySelectorAll('.day-pill').forEach(function(pill, i) {
    const active = (idx === -1 && i === 5) || idx === i;
    pill.className = active
      ? 'day-pill px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-teal-500/15 text-teal-300 border border-teal-500/30'
      : 'day-pill px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 hover:text-white border border-transparent';
  });

  renderScheduleView();
  syncRotaDayPillState();
}

function cleanDoctorName(name) {
  if (!name) return '';

  return String(name)
    .replace(/\s+P$/, '')
    .replace(/\s+\(IUCD\)$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s+\(SDI\)$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s+😎$/, '')
    .trim();
}

function isRealDoctor(name) {
  const cleaned = cleanDoctorName(name);

  return !!cleaned &&
    cleaned !== '-' &&
    cleaned !== 'No Clinic' &&
    cleaned !== 'To be determined' &&
    cleaned.indexOf('Unused') !== 0;
}

function makeEmptyMetric(docName) {
  return {
    doctor:docName, shifts:0, amShifts:0, pmShifts:0,
    maleER:0, femaleER:0, paedsER:0, wbc:0, ancNcd:0,
    codeBlueLead:0, codeBlueResponder:0, twilightAM:0, twilightPM:0,
    roomClinics:0
  };
}

function buildDutyStats() {
  const stats = {};

  DOCTORS.forEach(d => stats[d.name] = makeEmptyMetric(d.name));

  function ensure(name) {
    name = cleanDoctorName(name);
    if (!isRealDoctor(name)) return null;
    if (!stats[name]) stats[name] = makeEmptyMetric(name);
    return stats[name];
  }

  currentSchedule.forEach(day => {
    ['am','pm'].forEach(period => {
      const shift = day[period];
      const doctorsOnShift = {};

      function register(name) {
        name = cleanDoctorName(name);
        if (isRealDoctor(name)) {
          doctorsOnShift[name] = true;
          ensure(name);
        }
      }

      [shift.med,shift.fed,shift.ped,shift.timed1Doc,shift.timed2Doc,shift.wbcDoc,shift.ancDoc,shift.ncdDoc,shift.isoDoc,shift.smokingDoc,shift.iucdDoc,shift.sdiDoc].forEach(register);

      Object.keys(shift.rooms || {}).forEach(room => register(shift.rooms[room]));

      const cb = period === 'am' ? day.cbAM : day.cbPM;

      if (cb) {
        register(cb.tl);
        register(cb.tm2);
        register(cb.tm3);
      }

      Object.keys(doctorsOnShift).forEach(name => {
        const rec = ensure(name);
        rec.shifts++;
        if (period === 'am') rec.amShifts++;
        else rec.pmShifts++;
      });

      function inc(name, field) {
        const rec = ensure(name);
        if (rec) rec[field]++;
      }

      inc(shift.med,'maleER');
      inc(shift.fed,'femaleER');
      inc(shift.ped,'paedsER');
      inc(shift.wbcDoc,'wbc');
      inc(shift.ancDoc,'ancNcd');
      inc(shift

    : [];

  let remote = [];
  const endpoint = window.ROTASTIC_CLINICAL_UPDATE_ENDPOINT || '';

  if (endpoint) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(endpoint, {headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}});
      if (response.ok) {

        const items = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : (Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : []);

    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Clinical update feed unavailable:', e);
    }
  }

  const combined = Array.from(new Set(remote.concat(injected)));
  rotasticLiveClinicalUpdates = prioritizeClinicalUpdates(combined).slice(0,40);
  regularTickerDeck = [];
  regularTickerIndex = 0;
  return rotasticLiveClinicalUpdates;
}


function getPrayerMomentAlert(prayerTimes) {
  if (!prayerTimes) return null;

  const shift = getCurrentUserShiftWindow();
  if (!shift) return null;

  const now = getQatarClock().minutes;
  const names = ['Fajr','Dhuhr','Asr','Maghrib','Isha'];

  for (const name of names) {
    const value = prayerTimes[name];
    const minute = prayerTimeToMinutes(value);
    if (!value || minute === null) continue;

    // Only prayers that genuinely occur during this doctor's shift.
    if (minute < shift.startMinutes || minute > shift.endMinutes) continue;

    const delta = minute - now;
    if (delta < -10 || delta > 10) continue;

    let message = '';
    if (Math.abs(delta) <= 1) {
      message = `It is time for ${name} prayer.`;
    } else if (delta > 1) {
      message = `${name} prayer is in ${delta} minutes • ${value}.`;
    } else {
      message = `${name} prayer began ${Math.abs(delta)} minutes ago • ${value}.`;
    }

    return {
      name:name,
      time:value,
      delta:delta,
      message:message
    };
  }

  return null;
}

function getRelevantPrayerMessages(prayerTimes) {
  if (!prayerTimes) return [];

  const now = getQatarClock().minutes;
  const names = ['Fajr','Dhuhr','Asr','Maghrib','Isha'];
  const shift = getCurrentUserShiftWindow();

  const prayers = names
    .map(function(name) {
      return {
        name:name,
        value:prayerTimes[name],
        minute:prayerTimeToMinutes(prayerTimes[name])
      };
    })
    .filter(function(x) {
      return x.value && x.minute !== null;
    })
    .sort(function(a,b) { return a.minute - b.minute; });

  // If the doctor has a clinical shift today, only announce prayers that
  // are still upcoming and occur while that doctor is actually on duty.
  if (shift) {
    const shiftRelevant = prayers.filter(function(x) {
      return x.minute >= now &&
             x.minute >= shift.startMinutes &&
             x.minute <= shift.endMinutes;
    });

    if (shiftRelevant.length) {
      return shiftRelevant.map(function(x) {
        return `🕌 ${x.name} prayer during your shift is at ${x.value}.`;
      });
    }

    // Once every prayer within the shift has passed, do not announce an
    // unrelated prayer outside that doctor's working period.
    if (now >= shift.startMinutes && now <= shift.endMinutes) {
      return [];
    }
  }

  // Outside a scheduled shift, keep the general "next prayer" behaviour.
  const upcoming = prayers.filter(function(x) {
    return x.minute >= now;
  });

  if (upcoming.length) {
    return [`🕌 ${upcoming[0].name} prayer today is at ${upcoming[0].value}.`];
  }

  // After Isha, retain the earlier behaviour of pointing to tomorrow's Fajr.
  if (prayerTimes.Faj

===== KEY=fajr POS=1625605 =====

}

      message = `It is time for ${name} prayer.`;
    } else if (delta > 1) {
      message = `${name} prayer is in ${delta} minutes • ${value}.`;
    } else {
      message = `${name} prayer began ${Math.abs(delta)} minutes ago • ${value}.`;
    }

    return {
      name:name,
      time:value,
      delta:delta,
      message:message
    };
  }

  return null;
}

function getRelevantPrayerMessages(prayerTimes) {
  if (!prayerTimes) return [];

  const now = getQatarClock().minutes;
  const names = ['Fajr','Dhuhr','Asr','Maghrib','Isha'];
  const shift = getCurrentUserShiftWindow();

  const prayers = names
    .map(function(name) {
      return {
        name:name,
        value:prayerTimes[name],
        minute:prayerTimeToMinutes(prayerTimes[name])
      };
    })
    .filter(function(x) {
      return x.value && x.minute !== null;
    })
    .sort(function(a,b) { return a.minute - b.minute; });

  // If the doctor has a clinical shift today, only announce prayers that
  // are still upcoming and occur while that doctor is actually on duty.
  if (shift) {
    const shiftRelevant = prayers.filter(function(x) {
      return x.minute >= now &&
             x.minute >= shift.startMinutes &&
             x.minute <= shift.endMinutes;
    });

    if (shiftRelevant.length) {
      return shiftRelevant.map(function(x) {
        return `🕌 ${x.name} prayer during your shift is at ${x.value}.`;
      });
    }

    // Once every prayer within the shift has passed, do not announce an
    // unrelated prayer outside that doctor's working period.
    if (now >= shift.startMinutes && now <= shift.endMinutes) {
      return [];
    }
  }

  // Outside a scheduled shift, keep the general "next prayer" behaviour.
  const upcoming = prayers.filter(function(x) {
    return x.minute >= now;
  });

  if (upcoming.length) {
    return [`🕌 ${upcoming[0].name} prayer today is at ${upcoming[0].value}.`];
  }

  // After Isha, retain the earlier behaviour of pointing to tomorrow's Fajr.
  if (prayerTimes.Fajr) {
    return [`🕌 The next prayer is Fajr tomorrow at ${prayerTimes.Fajr}.`];
  }

  return [];
}

<script>
const Storage = {
  get(key, fallback) {
    try {
      const val = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return val !== null ? val : fallback;
    } catch (e) {
      return fallback;
    }
  },

  set(key, val) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, val);
      if (typeof rotasticBackendMirrorStorageChange === 'function') {
        rotasticBackendMirrorStorageChange(key, val, false);
      }
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  },

  getJSON(key, fallback) {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : fallback;
    } catch (e) {
      return fallback;
    }
  },

  setJSON(key, obj) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(obj));
      if (typeof rotasticBackendMirrorStorageChange === 'function') {
        rotasticBackendMirrorStorageChange(key, obj, true);
      }
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }
};

function rotasticBackendLocalSet(key, value, isJSON) {
  try {
    if (isJSON) localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
    else localStorage.setItem(key, String(value ?? ''));
  } catch (e) {}
}

function rotasticRegistrationSetStatus(message, ok) {
  const el = document.getElementById('rotasticRegStatus');
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = message || '';
  el.className = 'min-h-[20px] text-xs ' + (ok ? 'text-teal-300' : 'text-slate-400');
}

function rotasticRegistrationShow(show) {
  const gate = document.getElementById('rotasticRegistrationGate');
  if (!gate) return;
  gate.classList.toggle('rotastic-show', !!show);
  gate.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
  document.body.classList.toggle('rotastic-registration-open', !!show);
}

async function rotasticFinishAuthenticatedRegistration() {
  if (!rotasticBackendClient || !rotasticBackendUser) return false;
  const result = await rotasticBackendClient.rpc('rotastic_registration_identity');
  if (result.error) throw result.error;
  const identity = Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data[0] : result.data;
  if (!identity) throw new Error('This email is not authorised for ROTASTIC.');
  rotasticRegistrationIdentity = identity;
  rotasticVerifiedRole = identity.role || 'doctor';

  const verifiedEmail = document.getElementById('rotasticRegVerifiedEmail');
  if (verifiedEmail) verifiedEmail.textContent = identity.email || rotasticBackendUser.email || '';

  if (identity.registration_complete && identity.profile_physician_name) {
    rotasticApplyVerifiedIdentity(identity.profile_physician_name, identity.role, identity.email);
    return true;
  }

  if (identity.physician_name) {
    const claim = await rotasticBackendClient.rpc('rotastic_claim_profile',{p_physician_name:identity.physician_name});
    if (claim.error) throw claim.error;
    rotasticApplyVerifiedIdentity(identity.physician_name, identity.role, identity.email);
    return true;
  }

  rotasticRegistrationDoctorOptions(identity.role);
  rotasticShowRegistrationStage('claim');
  rotasticRegistrationShow(true);
  return false;
}

async function rotasticClaimVerifiedProfile() {
  const select = document.getElementById('rotasticRegDoctorSelect');
  const status = document.getElementById('rotasticRegClaimStatus');
  const name = String(select?.value || '').trim();
  if (!name) {
    if (status) status.textContent = 'Please select your name.';
    return;
  }
  try {
    if (status) status.textContent = 'Linking verified email to your profile…';
    const result = await rotasticBackendClient.rpc('rotastic_claim_profile',{p_physician_name:name});
    if (result.error) throw result.error;
    const row = Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data[0] : result.data;
    rotasticApplyVerifiedIdentity(name, row?.role || rotasticRegistrationIdentity?.role || 'doctor', rotasticRegistrationIdentity?.email || rotasticBackendUser?.email || '');
  } catch (e) {
    if (status) status.textContent = e?.message || 'Could not complete registration.';
  }
}

async function rotasticInitializeVerifiedRegistration() {
  try {
    // A previously activated Dr Zaid owner account remains activated across
    // reloads/new copies of this app on the same browser storage.
    if (rotasticHasStoredZaidPermanentIdentity()) {
      rotasticRegistrationIdentity = {
        email: ROTASTIC_ZAID_PERMANENT_EMAIL,
        role: 'zaid',
        physician_name: 'Dr Zaid SE.',
        profile_physician_name: 'Dr Zaid SE.',
        registration_complete: true,
        permanent: true
      };
      rotasticApplyVerifiedIdentity('Dr Zaid SE.', 'zaid', ROTASTIC_ZAID_PERMANENT_EMAIL);
      try { await rotasticBackendEnsureSession(); } catch (e) {}
      return true;
    }

    await rotasticBackendEnsureSession();
    if (!rotasticBackendClient) throw new Error('Authentication service unavailable');

    if (!rotasticAuthListenerBound) {
      rotasticAuthListenerBound = true;
      rotasticBackendClient.auth.onAuthStateChange(function(event, session){
        rotasticBackendUser = session?.user || null;
        if (session?.user) setTimeout(function(){ rotasticFinishAuthenticatedRegistration().catch(function(e){ console.warn('ROTASTIC registration:',e?.message||e); }); }, 0);
      });
    }

    if (!rotasticBackendUser) {
      // A device that has previously completed activation gets one final silent
      // restoration attempt before the gate is shown. This avoids asking for a
      // one-time code again merely because startup/network timing was slow.
      if (rotasticHasStoredActivatedIdentity()) {
        await new Promise(function(resolve){ setTimeout(resolve, 250); });
        await rotasticBackendEnsureSession();
      }
      if (!rotasticBackendUser) {
        rotasticShowRegistrationStage('email');
        rotasticRegistrationShow(true);
        return false;
      }
    }

    return await rotasticFinishAuthenticatedRegistration();
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('ROTASTIC registration init:', e?.message || e);
    rotasticRegistrationShow(true);
    rotasticRegistrationSetStatus(e?.message || 'Sign-in is required.', false);
    return false;
  }
}

function rotasticBackendIsoFromMillis(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
  const n = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? new Date(n).toISOString() : null;
}

function rotasticBackendMillisFromIso(value) {
  if (!value) return null;
  const n = new Date(value).getTime();
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}

async function rotasticBackendEnsureSession() {
  // The Supabase bundle is loaded from the network. On a fast app launch it can
  // arrive a fraction later than ROTASTIC's own bootstrap. Wait briefly before
  // deciding that an already-activated device needs registration again.
  if (!window.supabase || !window.supabase.createClient) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      await new Promise(function(resolve){ setTimeout(resolve, 150); });
      if (window.supabase && window.supabase.createClient) break;
    }
  }
  if (!window.supabase || !window.supabase.createClient) return null;

  if (!rotasticBackendClient) {
    rotasticBackendClient = window.supabase.createClient(
      ROTASTIC_SUPABASE_URL,
      ROTASTIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY,
      { auth:{ persistSession:true, autoRefreshToken:true, detectSessionInUrl:true, storageKey:'rotastic-auth-session-v1' } }
    );
  }

  // getSession reads the persisted refresh/access session from this device.
  // Do not show the activation gate until this restoration attempt has finished.
  const existing = await rotasticBackendClient.auth.g

===== KEY=isha POS=932425 =====
ationSetStatus(e?.message || 'Sign-in is required.', false);
    return false;
  }
}

function rotasticBackendIsoFromMillis(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;
  const n = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? new Date(n).toISOString() : null;
}

function rotasticBackendMillisFromIso(value) {
  if (!value) return null;
  const n = new Date(value).getTime();
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}

async function rotasticBackendEnsureSession() {
  // The Supabase bundle is loaded from the network. On a fast app launch it can
  // arrive a fraction later than ROTASTIC's own bootstrap. Wait briefly before
  // deciding that an already-activated device needs registration again.
  if (!window.supabase || !window.supabase.createClient) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      await new Promise(function(resolve){ setTimeout(resolve, 150); });
      if (window.supabase && window.supabase.createClient) break;
    }
  }
  if (!window.supabase || !window.supabase.createClient) return null;

  if (!rotasticBackendClient) {
    rotasticBackendClient = window.supabase.createClient(
      ROTASTIC_SUPABASE_URL,
      ROTASTIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY,
      { auth:{ persistSession:true, autoRefreshToken:true, detectSessionInUrl:true, storageKey:'rotastic-auth-session-v1' } }
    );
  }

  // getSession reads the persisted refresh/access session from this device.
  // Do not show the activation gate until this restoration attempt has finished.
  const existing = await rotasticBackendClient.auth.getSession();
  const session = existing?.data?.session || null;
  rotasticBackendUser = session?.user || null;
  return rotasticBackendUser;
}

async function rotasticBackendSyncProfile() {
  if (!rotasticBackendClient || !rotasticBackendUser) return;
  // Physician identity is now created/bound only through the verified-email
  // registration RPC. Do not overwrite it from editable localStorage.
  const identityResult = await rotasticBackendClient.rpc('rotastic_registration_identity');
  if (identityResult.error) return;
  const identity = Array.isArray(identityResult.data) ? identityResult.data[0] : identityResult.data;
  if (!identity || !identity.profile_physician_name) return;
  const physician = identity.profile_physician_name;
  activeUserDocName = physician;
  rotasticVerifiedRole = identity.role || 'doctor';
  rotasticBackendLocalSet('rotastic_user_doc_name', physician, false);
  const result = await rotasticBackendClient.from('rotastic_profiles').update({
    device_label:(navigator.userAgent || 'ROTASTIC device').slice(0,180),
    last_seen_at:new Date().toISOString()
  }).eq('user_id',rotasticBackendUser.id);
  if (result.error) console.warn('ROTASTIC backend profile heartbeat:', result.error.message);
}

function rotasticBackendMapLeaveRow(row, existing) {
  return Object.assign({}, existing || {}, {
    id:row.id,
    type:row.leave_type,
    typeLabel:row.type_label || row.leave_type || 'Leave',
    emoji:row.emoji || '📝',
    doc:row.physician_name,
    startDate:row.start_date,
    endDate:row.end_date || row.start_date,
    notes:row.notes || '',
    shift:row.shift || '',
    status:row.status || 'Submitted for approval',
    createdAt:row.created_at,
    approvedAt:row.approved_at || undefined,
    approvedBy:row.approved_by_name || undefined
  });
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value)
    .replace(/&/g,'&amp;')
    .replace(/</g,'&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g,'&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g,'&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g,'&#039;');
}


function canViewAnnouncements() {
  return true;
}


const ROTASTIC_PUSH_BROADCAST_ENDPOINT =
  window.ROTASTIC_PUSH_BROADCAST_ENDPOINT || '';

async function rotasticPushBackendFetch(options) {
  if (!ROTASTIC_PUSH_BROADCAST_ENDPOINT) throw new Error('Push endpoint is not configured');
  let token = '';
  try {
    if (rotasticBackendClient && rotasticBackendClient.auth) {
      const sessionResult = await rotasticBackendClient.auth.getSession();
      token = sessionResult && sessionResult.data && sessionResult.data.session
        ? String(sessionResult.data.session.access_token || '')
        : '';
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  if (!token) throw new Error('Authenticated ROTASTIC session required for push');

  const opts = Object.assign({}, options || {});
  opts.headers = Object.assign({}, opts.headers || {}, {
    'Authorization':'Bearer ' + token,
    'apikey':ROTASTIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
  });
  return fetch(ROTASTIC_PUSH_BROADCAST_ENDPOINT, opts);
}

async function sendAnnouncementPushToAll(messageText) {
  if (!messageText) return { ok: false, reason: 'empty' };

  // Real multi-device push requires a shared backend/Web Push service.
  // If an endpoint is configured by deployment, send the announcement there.
  if (ROTASTIC_PUSH_BROADCAST_ENDPOINT) {
    try {
      const response = await rotasticPushBackendFetch({
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type: 'announcement',
          title: 'ROTASTIC Announcement',
          body: messageText,
          centre: 'Abu Nakhla Health Centre',
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
        })
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Push broadcast request failed');
      }

      return { ok: true, mode: 'backend' };
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('ROTASTIC push broadcast failed:', error);
      return { ok: false, reason: 'backend-failed' };
    }
  }

  // Local-device notification fallback only.
  try {
    if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'granted') {
      new Notification('ROTASTIC Announcement', {
        body: messageText,
        icon: undefined
      });
      return { ok: true, mode: 'local-only' };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Local announcement notification failed:', error);
  }

  return { ok: false, reason: 'no-push-backend' };
}


function getRotaApprovalWorkflow() {
  return Storage.getJSON('rotastic_rota_approval_workflow', null);
}

function setRotaApprovalWorkflow(workflow) {
  Storage.setJSON('rotastic_rota_approval_workflow', workflow || {});
}

let rotasticGenerationLockCache = {locked:false, unlock_at:null, week_start:null, status:null};

function rotasticNextWednesday2200After(iso) {
  if (!iso) return null;
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {timeZone:'Asia/Qatar',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).formatToParts(d);
  const m={}; parts.forEach(function(x){ if(x.type!=='literal') m[x.type]=x.value; });
  const base = new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m.year), Number(m.month)-1, Number(m.day), 19, 0, 0));
  const dow = base.getUTCDay();
  let days = (3 - dow + 7) % 7;
  if (days === 0) days = 7;
  base.setUTCDate(base.getUTCDate() + days);
  return base.toISOString();
}
